start.title: Głos z wysoka
start.text:
Bóg przemawia do ciebie.
„Zbuduj sobie arkę. Nadchodzi potop.”

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: Obserwujący świat
mockery.text:
Świat wokół ciebie jest zepsuty i pełen przemocy.
Obserwują, jak budujesz. Jak reagujesz?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: Cyprys i smoła
building.text:
Zbierasz materiały, które nakazał Bóg.
Jak budujesz arkę?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: Stoi ukończona
ark_done.text:
Arka jest ukończona, dokładnie tak, jak nakazał Bóg.
Jak wygląda?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

animals.title: Nadchodzą stworzenia
animals.text:
Zwierzęta przybywają do arki.
Kogo zabierasz na pokład?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: Drzwi zamknięte
boarding.text:
Nadszedł czas, aby wejść do arki.
Kto wchodzi, a kto zamyka drzwi?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

storm.title: Czterdzieści dni deszczu
storm.text:
Otwierają się okna nieba.
Co się dzieje?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: Na wodach
inside.text:
Arka unosi się na głębinach.
Jak długo wody panują na ziemi?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: Gołębica wraca
dove.text:
Wody zaczynają opadać.
Skąd wiesz, że suchy ląd jest blisko?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: Ziemia pod twoimi stopami
dry_land.text:
Pan każe ci wyjść z arki.
Co robisz najpierw na suchym lądzie?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: Tęcza
covenant.text:
Tęcza rozciąga się na niebie.
„Nigdy więcej nie zatopię ziemi. To jest moje przymierze z tobą.”
